svg.desc: Both models use the same training rows, scaling and frozen settings. Background color is a class-one score, dark contours mark threshold one-half, and points are eighty held-out observations with circle and triangle shapes as well as color indicating the true classes in the separate key. A curved boundary can represent the ring relation; the score map does not establish probability calibration or real-world performance.
svg.title: Linear and neural decision functions on held-out synthetic rings
